title: Rehabilitating Homeless: Dataset and Key Insights*
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research. The findings relate to socio-demographic and situational factors that positively or negatively impact the success of rehabilitation for homeless individuals.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures the performance of various machine learning models in predicting the success of rehabilitation contracts for homeless individuals based on their personal data.
